description: This file defines localization culture info for the Urdu (Pakistan) locale in the DateJS library, including date formats, month and day names, regex patterns, and date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Clears the time component from a Date object, setting hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets a Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object set to the current date with the time cleared.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two dates, returning -1, 0, or 1 depending on their order.
